tool_args.rationale: The data show gradient-dependent short-horizon response and long-horizon reversal. Fit and compare explicit stationary models in which sink gradient modifies dual-timescale adaptation, then test the selected fit on fresh confirmation; its success is not assumed.

considered_alternatives.option: Previously submitted additive and gradient-coupled adaptation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation refuted those particular implementations; this candidate instead allows sink gradient to alter a relaxation rate or slow-response amplitude.
The available trajectory batch has already been acquired, and the current observations cover both short and long horizons.
The observed reversal does not show chaotic high-frequency oscillation, and the prior failures do not refute every stationary smooth mechanism.
